strategy_candidates.name: Evidence-first
strategy_candidates.description: Prioritize independent convergence between explicit request, delegation, deliverable and verification.

strategy_candidates.name: Opportunity-first
strategy_candidates.description: Favor potentially executable opportunities earlier and verify them through context.

strategy_candidates.name: Adaptive balanced
strategy_candidates.description: Combine evidence convergence, historical outcomes, live testing and self-detected errors without allowing history to override current evidence.

reasons: Strong protection against known false-positive classes.
Preserves discovery sensitivity and atypical signals.
Combines evidence, outcomes, live testing and self-analysis.
V88 identified weaknesses that should influence future arbitration.

preferred_strategy.name: Adaptive balanced
preferred_strategy.description: Combine evidence convergence, historical outcomes, live testing and self-detected errors without allowing history to override current evidence.
preferred_strategy.reason: This strategy currently provides the best balance between evidence quality, opportunity discovery, adaptation and self-correction.

recommendations: Keep primary-source verification as a hard evidence priority.
Do not interpret reward language as proof of settlement.
Do not penalize a decision solely because nobody responded.
Preserve atypical opportunities instead of filtering them automatically.
Use historical outcomes to modify priority, not to establish truth.
Use V88 decision errors as correction signals for future arbitration.
Prefer strategies that improve both precision and opportunity recovery.

conclusions: NØX can now compare competing strategies rather than relying on one fixed policy.
Strategy quality must be judged against both false positives and missed opportunities.
Live evidence and self-detected errors are stronger signals than intuition.
A strategy should not become permanent because of one successful or unsuccessful case.
The preferred strategy must remain revisable when new evidence contradicts it.
The arbitration process itself should become measurable in V90+.

next_stage.purpose: Begin the autonomous decision framework: NØX evaluates evidence, priorities, strategy and past results as one decision system.
